Synopsis:
The USDA is rolling out measures to support the US beef industry amid record consumer prices driven by drought/wildfire-depleted cattle herds at 75-year lows. Actions include guaranteed loans for small meat processors, grazing access on conserved lands post-disaster, and expanded lower-tariff beef imports signed by Trump. The broader policy push targets meatpacker consolidation and supply-side rebuilding of the US cattle herd.
